raw_response:
I will not do anything fancy this year. I have too much land to gamble on 349.9 mu, so I will do mostly what has worked before and what I see the bigger growers around me doing. Sweetpotato is my main crop, so I will keep the biggest piece there. Maize is steady and easy to sell, so I will still keep a good block of it. Millet I will keep on a smaller piece because it needs less fertilizer, costs less, and gives me some safety if weather turns rough. I have well water, so I will not let the field stay dry at the key time. For maize, I will feed it heavier because if maize is hungry the ears go small fast. For millet, I will keep fertilizer lighter because too much is a waste there. For sweetpotato, I will not push too much nitrogen or I will get too much vine and not enough root, so I will give more potash there. I will plough the sweetpotato land and most maize land, because on big area I want the soil loose and clean at the start. I will spray when needed, but I will not try to save small money on pests and lose big money on yield. This is how I will keep it steady and protect the harvest.
